Text: Did you make it home ok sweet pea?
Well you're home now. That's what matters 😊
Oh sweet pea I knew you would! Proud of you, always have been.
Call me tonight and tell me everything
How do you make your peach cobbler again?
Butter in the pan first, let it melt in the oven. Don't skimp on the cinnamon! 😊
And don't tell your uncle the secret
Rough week. Feeling kind of down
Oh honey. Rough weeks end. Go sit in the sun a bit, drink some water, and call your mama.
Proud of you sweet pea. Always.
